title: Flower pot with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- pot body -->
  <path d='M28 55 L34 88 Q35 93 40 93 L60 93 Q65 93 66 88 L72 55 Z' fill='#E8734A' stroke='#F4A261' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- pot rim -->
  <rect x='24' y='47' width='52' height='13' rx='5' fill='#C85A35' stroke='#F4A261' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- soil -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='48' rx='22' ry='6' fill='#5B3A29' stroke='#7A5540' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- stem -->
  <rect x='47.5' y='22' width='5' height='26' rx='2.5' fill='#4CAF50' stroke='#81C784' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- leaf left -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='32' rx='10' ry='5' fill='#66BB6A' stroke='#A5D6A7' stroke-width='1.5' transform='rotate(-25 38 32)'/>
  <!-- leaf right -->
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='32' rx='10' ry='5' fill='#66BB6A' stroke='#A5D6A7' stroke-width='1.5' transform='rotate(25 62 32)'/>
  <!-- flower petals -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='12' r='9' fill='#FF6B8A'/>
  <circle cx='41' cy='18' r='9' fill='#FF6B8A'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='18' r='9' fill='#FF6B8A'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='24' r='8' fill='#FF6B8A'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='24' r='8' fill='#FF6B8A'/>
  <!-- petal highlights -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='12' r='9' fill='none' stroke='#FF9EB5' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <circle cx='41' cy='18' r='9' fill='none' stroke='#FF9EB5' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='18' r='9' fill='none' stroke='#FF9EB5' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- flower center -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='19' r='7' fill='#FFD54F' stroke='#FFE082' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- face on pot -->
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='66' r='4' fill='#2E1A0F' stroke='#6D4C41' stroke-width='1'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='66' r='4' fill='#2E1A0F' stroke='#6D4C41' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- eye sparkles -->
  <circle cx='42.5' cy='64.5' r='1.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='60.5' cy='64.5' r='1.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M40 74 Q50 83 60 74' fill='none' stroke='#2E1A0F' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- blush -->
  <ellipse cx='35' cy='72' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#F4A0A0' opacity='0.8'/>
  <ellipse cx='65' cy='72' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#F4A0A0' opacity='0.8'/>
</svg>
